payload.description:
This market refers to the pre-match coin toss for the cricket match between Austria and Israel scheduled for 2026-07-27 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to the official coin toss result (the team recorded as having won the toss) as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
If an official toss winner is recorded, the market will resolve based on that result even if the match is subsequently delayed, relocated, abandoned, or no ball is bowled.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market will remain open and resolve according to the toss result for the listed fixture when it is eventually played.
If the fixture is permanently canceled, forfeited before any toss is conducted, or otherwise completed without an official toss winner being recorded, the market will resolve 50-50.

event_message.description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Austria and Israel scheduled for July 28 2026 in T20 European Cup.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

This market refers to which team hits the greater number of sixes in the cricket match between Austria and Israel scheduled for 2026-07-27 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to the finalized match statistics as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Austria will be considered correct if Austria is officially recorded as hitting more sixes than Israel.The outcome corresponding to Israel will be considered correct if Israel is officially recorded as hitting more sixes than Austria.
If both teams record the same number of sixes, the market will resolve to "Draw".
The market will resolve according to the team that hits the greater number of sixes in the match regardless of if the match is not competed (e.g. Due to weather conditions)/
Only sixes scored from the bat (off any delivery- legal or not) will count towards the total sixes. Overthrows and extras do not count. Sixes scored in a super over do not count.
In First Class games, only first innings sixes will count.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official sixes statistics being recorded, the market will resolve "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the WTA Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

payload.description:
This market refers to which team's player records the highest individual run total in the cricket match between Austria and Israel scheduled for 2026-07-27 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to the finalized match statistics as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Austria will be considered correct if the highest individual score in the match is recorded exclusively by a player from Austria.
The outcome corresponding to Israel will be considered correct if the highest individual score is recorded exclusively by a player from Israel.
If the highest individual score is shared by at least one player from each team, the market will resolve to Draw.

If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

This market refers to which team hits the greater number of sixes in the cricket match between Turkiye and Israel scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to the finalized match statistics as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Turkiye will be considered correct if Turkiye is officially recorded as hitting more sixes than Israel.The outcome corresponding to Israel will be considered correct if Israel is officially recorded as hitting more sixes than Turkiye.
If both teams record the same number of sixes, the market will resolve to "Draw".
The market will resolve according to the team that hits the greater number of sixes in the match regardless of if the match is not competed (e.g. Due to weather conditions)/
Only sixes scored from the bat (off any delivery- legal or not) will count towards the total sixes. Overthrows and extras do not count. Sixes scored in a super over do not count.
In First Class games, only first innings sixes will count.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official sixes statistics being recorded, the market will resolve "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

payload.description:
This market refers to which team hits the greater number of sixes in the cricket match between Turkiye and Israel scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to the finalized match statistics as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Turkiye will be considered correct if Turkiye is officially recorded as hitting more sixes than Israel.The outcome corresponding to Israel will be considered correct if Israel is officially recorded as hitting more sixes than Turkiye.
If both teams record the same number of sixes, the market will resolve to "Draw".
The market will resolve according to the team that hits the greater number of sixes in the match regardless of if the match is not competed (e.g. Due to weather conditions)/
Only sixes scored from the bat (off any delivery- legal or not) will count towards the total sixes. Overthrows and extras do not count. Sixes scored in a super over do not count.
In First Class games, only first innings sixes will count.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official sixes statistics being recorded, the market will resolve "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

payload.description:
This market refers to the combination of the pre-match coin toss and the final match result for the cricket match between France and Austria scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to (1) the official toss result and (2) the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to France will be considered correct if  France is officially recorded as winning both the toss and the match.
The outcome corresponding to Austria will be considered correct if Austria is officially recorded as winning both the toss and the match.
In all other cases - including where the toss and match winners differ, or where no match winner is recorded - the market will resolve to "Draw".
DLS/DRS adjustments, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, Super Over, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a match winner are treated as ordinary wins. If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the tiebreak winner will be considered the match winner for this market. If the match ends tied with no tiebreak used or available, no team will be considered to have won the match and the market will resolve to "Draw".
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without an official match winner being declared, the market will resolve to "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and will then resolve as described above.

This market refers to which team's player records the highest individual run total in the cricket match between France and Austria scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 European Cup.
This market resolves according to the finalized match statistics as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to France will be considered correct if the highest individual score in the match is recorded exclusively by a player from France.
The outcome corresponding to Austria will be considered correct if the highest individual score is recorded exclusively by a player from Austria.
If the highest individual score is shared by at least one player from each team, the market will resolve to Draw.
The market will resolve according to which team's player records the highest individual run total regardless of if the match is not competed (e.g. Due to weather conditions).
DLS/DRS adjustments and any other on-field rulings affecting batting statistics are treated as ordinary data.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official batting statistics being recorded, the market will resolve Draw.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

This market refers to the combination of the pre-match coin toss and the final match result for the cricket match between Jaffna Kings and Colombo Kaps scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 Lanka Premier League.
This market resolves according to (1) the official toss result and (2) the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Jaffna Kings will be considered correct if  Jaffna Kings is officially recorded as winning both the toss and the match.
The outcome corresponding to Colombo Kaps will be considered correct if Colombo Kaps is officially recorded as winning both the toss and the match.
In all other cases - including where the toss and match winners differ, or where no match winner is recorded - the market will resolve to "Draw".
DLS/DRS adjustments, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, Super Over, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a match winner are treated as ordinary wins. If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the tiebreak winner will be considered the match winner for this market. If the match ends tied with no tiebreak used or available, no team will be considered to have won the match and the market will resolve to "Draw".
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without an official match winner being declared, the market will resolve to "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and will then resolve as described above.

This market refers to which team's player records the highest individual run total in the cricket match between Namibia and Hong Kong, China scheduled for 2026-07-27 in T20 Namibia Quadrangular Series, Women.

The outcome corresponding to Namibia will be considered correct if the highest individual score in the match is recorded exclusively by a player from Namibia.
The outcome corresponding to Hong Kong, China will be considered correct if the highest individual score is recorded exclusively by a player from Hong Kong, China.
If the highest individual score is shared by at least one player from each team, the market will resolve to Draw.

DLS/DRS adjustments and any other on-field rulings affecting batting statistics are treated as ordinary data.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official batting statistics being recorded, the market will resolve Draw.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

This market refers to the pre-match coin toss for the cricket match between Namibia and Hong Kong, China scheduled for 2026-07-27 in T20 Namibia Quadrangular Series, Women.
This market resolves according to the official coin toss result (the team recorded as having won the toss) as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
If an official toss winner is recorded, the market will resolve based on that result even if the match is subsequently delayed, relocated, abandoned, or no ball is bowled.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market will remain open and resolve according to the toss result for the listed fixture when it is eventually played.
If the fixture is permanently canceled, forfeited before any toss is conducted, or otherwise completed without an official toss winner being recorded, the market will resolve 50-50.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

If both teams record the same number of sixes, the market will resolve to "Draw".
The market will resolve according to the team that hits the greater number of sixes in the match regardless of if the match is not competed (e.g. Due to weather conditions)/
Only sixes scored from the bat (off any delivery- legal or not) will count towards the total sixes. Overthrows and extras do not count. Sixes scored in a super over do not count.
In First Class games, only first innings sixes will count.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official sixes statistics being recorded, the market will resolve "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

This market refers to which team's player records the highest individual run total in the cricket match between Jaffna Kings and Colombo Kaps scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 Lanka Premier League.
This market resolves according to the finalized match statistics as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Jaffna Kings will be considered correct if the highest individual score in the match is recorded exclusively by a player from Jaffna Kings.
The outcome corresponding to Colombo Kaps will be considered correct if the highest individual score is recorded exclusively by a player from Colombo Kaps.
If the highest individual score is shared by at least one player from each team, the market will resolve to Draw.
The market will resolve according to which team's player records the highest individual run total regardless of if the match is not competed (e.g. Due to weather conditions).
DLS/DRS adjustments and any other on-field rulings affecting batting statistics are treated as ordinary data.
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without official batting statistics being recorded, the market will resolve Draw.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and official statistics are available.

payload.description:
This market refers to the pre-match coin toss for the cricket match between Jaffna Kings and Colombo Kaps scheduled for 2026-07-28 in T20 Lanka Premier League.
This market resolves according to the official coin toss result (the team recorded as having won the toss) as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
If an official toss winner is recorded, the market will resolve based on that result even if the match is subsequently delayed, relocated, abandoned, or no ball is bowled.
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market will remain open and resolve according to the toss result for the listed fixture when it is eventually played.
If the fixture is permanently canceled, forfeited before any toss is conducted, or otherwise completed without an official toss winner being recorded, the market will resolve 50-50.

event_message.description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Jaffna Kings and Colombo Kaps scheduled for July 28 2026 in T20 Lanka Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. If the match ends tied and no on-field tiebreak is used or available under the playing conditions (e.g., group-stage ODI with no Super Over), the market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed/rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed. If the match is permanently canceled or abandoned or otherwise is completed without a winner, the market resolves 50-50.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

This market refers to the combination of the pre-match coin toss and the final match result for the cricket match between Colombo Kaps and Dambulla Sixers scheduled for 2026-07-29 in T20 Lanka Premier League.
This market resolves according to (1) the official toss result and (2) the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.
The outcome corresponding to Colombo Kaps will be considered correct if  Colombo Kaps is officially recorded as winning both the toss and the match.
The outcome corresponding to Dambulla Sixers will be considered correct if Dambulla Sixers is officially recorded as winning both the toss and the match.
In all other cases - including where the toss and match winners differ, or where no match winner is recorded - the market will resolve to "Draw".
DLS/DRS adjustments, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, Super Over, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a match winner are treated as ordinary wins. If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the tiebreak winner will be considered the match winner for this market. If the match ends tied with no tiebreak used or available, no team will be considered to have won the match and the market will resolve to "Draw".
If the match is permanently canceled, abandoned, or otherwise completed without an official match winner being declared, the market will resolve to "Draw".
If the match is postponed or rescheduled, the market remains open until the listed fixture is completed and will then resolve as described above.
